title: Design a URL Shortener (TinyURL)
traffic: 500 Million new URLs per month (100:1 read/write ratio)

steps.title: Requirements Clarification
steps.prompt: Clarify functional and non-functional requirements. What must the system do, and what are its performance SLAs?

steps.title: Traffic & Capacity Estimations
steps.prompt: Calculate write QPS, read QPS, bandwidth, and cache memory required for 20% hot URLs (80-20 rule).
expectedDecisions: Cache memory: ~34 GB RAM per day

steps.title: Key Generation & Data Storage
steps.prompt: How do you generate unique short keys without write collisions or DB race conditions?
expectedDecisions: Pre-generate unique 7-char Base62 keys with Key Generation Service (KGS)
Store mapping in NoSQL Key-Value or partitioned SQL

steps.title: Caching & Latency Optimization
steps.prompt: Where do you place caches, and what eviction policy do you choose?
expectedDecisions: Distributed Redis cache in front of DB

steps.title: Scaling & Fault Tolerance
steps.prompt: How do you handle regional outages and database shard failures?

steps.title: Requirements & Scope
steps.prompt: Define core chat requirements: 1-on-1 messaging, group chats, delivery status (sent, delivered, read), offline messaging.

steps.title: Connection & Protocol Selection
steps.prompt: Which network protocol will you choose for maintaining millions of concurrent bi-directional connections?

steps.title: Message Routing & Presence
steps.prompt: How do you track which server holds the active connection for User B, and route User A's message to User B?
expectedDecisions: Session Service backed by Redis cluster
Distributed message queue (Kafka/Pulsar) for temporary buffering

steps.title: Storage Architecture
steps.prompt: How do you store transient unread messages vs historical chat logs?
expectedDecisions: Wide-column store (Apache Cassandra/ScyllaDB) partitioned by (chat_id, message_id)

title: Design Twitter / X (News Feed System)
traffic: 300 Million DAU, 500 Million tweets/day, massive celebrity fanout

steps.title: Feed Generation Model: Fanout on Write vs Fanout on Read
steps.prompt: How do you handle the celebrity problem (e.g. user with 100M followers tweets)?
expectedDecisions: Hybrid approach: Fanout-on-write (push) for normal users, Fanout-on-read (pull) for high-follower celebrities

steps.title: Timeline Caching
steps.prompt: How is a user's home timeline cached and served in <50ms?
expectedDecisions: In-memory Redis timeline ring buffer (e.g. 800 recent tweet IDs per active user)
Hydrate tweet entities via multi-get cache

title: Design a Video Streaming Platform (Netflix)
storage: Petabytes of multi-bitrate encoded video chunks

steps.title: Video Ingestion & Transcoding
steps.prompt: How do you process source video files into streamable formats across varying client bandwidths?
expectedDecisions: Transcoding DAG into HLS/DASH at multiple bitrates (Adaptive Bitrate Streaming)

steps.title: CDN Edge Delivery
steps.prompt: How do you ensure zero buffering and high throughput for global video playback?
expectedDecisions: Custom Open Connect CDN appliances deployed at ISP internet exchange points (IXPs)

title: Design a Ride-Sharing Service (Uber)
traffic: 50 Million daily trips, 5 Million active drivers reporting GPS every 4 seconds

steps.title: Real-time Geospatial Indexing
steps.prompt: How do you index millions of continuously moving driver coordinates to quickly find nearest drivers?
expectedDecisions: Geohash or Uber H3 hexagonal spatial index
In-memory geospatial cluster (Redis GEO or Google S2 / Quadtrees)

steps.title: Ride Matching & Dispatch
steps.prompt: How do you match a rider request to the optimal driver without race conditions?
expectedDecisions: Ring buffer / Dispatch lock per driver
WebSocket connection for driver accept/reject modal
